scenes.spoken_text: Serving large models is a fight against three walls at once: throughput, latency, and cost.
scenes.visual_directive: Draw a triangle labeled Throughput, Latency, Cost.

scenes.spoken_text: The real wall is memory. Every token drags the KV cache across a bandwidth ceiling that FLOPs cannot fix.
scenes.visual_directive: Draw GPU box left, HBM box right, arrow between labeled bandwidth.

scenes.spoken_text: vLLM pages the KV cache like virtual memory and batches continuously, roughly doubling serving throughput.
scenes.visual_directive: Draw stacked page rectangles inside KV Cache box; arrow labeled continuous batching.
